# tessera-kit

> A server wants to let a member answer "is my friend here?" without publishing
> its member list and without a who's-here lookup API (which would log interest
> and centralise the social graph). tessera-kit lets the server publish one
> signed, immutable blob per epoch; a member who already holds a friend's pubkey
> tests that one key against the blob LOCALLY. The blob carries 16-bit
> fingerprints, not keys, so members cannot be enumerated.

tessera-kit is a TypeScript library for non-enumerable membership-presence
filters, built on a clean-room Binary Fuse 16 port with a custom signed byte
format (`KFLT`). ESM-only, Node ≥ 22. Three deps: `@noble/curves`,
`@noble/hashes`, `@scure/base` (the last one pulled in only by the optional
`./nostr` subpath, for base64 — the core `.` and `./capability` entries stay
`@noble`-only). It is the membership-presence brick of the Forgesworn / Signet
ecosystem and is consumed by `kenspeckle` (relationships + discovery).

## Getting Started

```
npm i @forgesworn/tessera-kit
```

```typescript
import {
  memberKey, buildMembershipFilter, serializeFilter, signFilterBlob,
  verifyAndParseFilter, testMembership,
} from '@forgesworn/tessera-kit'

// `context` is the deployment's stable, out-of-band-known address — e.g. a
// kindred d-tag `kindred:members:<ns>:<serverId>`. Required on both sides.
const context = `kindred:members:${namespace}:${serverId}`

// Server: build an open pool, serialize, sign in place (bound to `context`),
// publish the bytes.
const f = buildMembershipFilter(pubkeys.map((pk) => memberKey(pk)), { epoch })
const blob = serializeFilter(f)
signFilterBlob(blob, serverPrivHex, context)

// Client: pin-verify (key AND context) + parse in one call — the recommended
// path — then test a held friend key.
const filter = verifyAndParseFilter(blob, { pinnedPubkeyHex: PINNED_SERVER_PUBKEY, context })
const present = testMembership(filter, memberKey(friendPubkey))
```

## Key Concepts

- **memberKey** — the value inserted/tested: the pubkey (open pool) or
  `sha256(salt ‖ pubkey)` (keyed pool). The salt is never in the blob.
- **Open vs keyed** — open = discoverable by anyone holding the pubkey; keyed =
  a speed-bump (needs the out-of-band salt), NOT a member-privacy boundary.
- **KFLT blob** — 128-byte header (magic/version/flags/epoch/32-bit seed/geometry/
  signer-pubkey/Schnorr sig) + a u16 fingerprint array. See PROTOCOL.md.
- **Provenance signature** — Schnorr over a digest bound to a caller-supplied
  `context` string (the deployment's stable address) plus
  `blob[0..64) ‖ sha256(blob[128..end))`. `verifyFilterBlob(blob, context)`
  checks consistency; trust = comparing the signer to a PINNED key AND the
  context to your own deployment's address — a wrong context fails exactly
  like a bad signature (no distinguishable error).
- **Capability token** — subject-signed consent to be located (`./capability`); a
  BEARER token (reusable until `expiresAt`, not one-time), whose `memberValue`
  field reveals only the subject's own pool value, never the pool salt; still
  pin-verify the filter.
- **Padding** — rounds the member count to a power-of-two bucket with decoys.
  Pass `decoySeedHex` (≥16 bytes hex) for decoys that are stable WITHIN an epoch
  but automatically re-keyed PER epoch (derived from `decoySeedHex + epoch`) —
  this is what stops epoch-to-epoch churn-diffing; a decoy set reused forever
  does NOT (fuse slots are XOR-shared, so a fixed set diffs exactly with churn).

## API Surface

`.`:
- `memberKey(pubkeyHex, saltHex?)` — derive the open/keyed insert/test value
- `buildMembershipFilter(valuesHex, opts)` — build a Binary Fuse 16 filter (`opts.epoch` required)
- `testMembership(filter, valueHex)` — local membership test (no false negatives; FP ≈ 2⁻¹⁶)
- `testMany(filter, valuesHex)` — test many values in one call; same validation/semantics as calling `testMembership` on each
- `describeFilter(filter)` — public read-only metadata view (`fingerprintBits`, `filterType`, `keyed`, `padded`, `epoch`, `memberCountBand`, `segmentLength`, `segmentCount`, `arrayLength`, `byteLength`, `theoreticalFalsePositiveRate`); reveals nothing beyond the serialized header
- `serializeFilter(filter)` / `parseFilter(blob)` — KFLT encode / hardened decode
- `signFilterBlob(blob, signerPrivHex, context)` — sign in place (Schnorr), `context` required (non-empty, well-formed UTF-16, ≤1024 UTF-8 bytes) and bound into the digest
- `verifyFilterBlob(blob, context)` — `{ signerPubkeyHex, ok }`; never throws on hostile blob input (throws on a malformed `context`)
- `verifyAndParseFilter(blob, { pinnedPubkeyHex, context, minEpoch?, strictlyNewerThan? })` — recommended: pin-verify + parse + freshness in one call; use the RETURNED `filter.epoch` for freshness, never a Nostr `epoch` tag. `strictlyNewerThan` (optional) rejects a same-or-older epoch, stricter than `minEpoch` alone
- `nextPowerOfTwoBand(n)` / `deriveDecoys(seedHex, count)` — size band + deterministic decoy derivation (a given `(seedHex, count)` always yields the same decoys; see "Padding" above for why `buildMembershipFilter` re-keys this per epoch rather than using a caller's `decoySeedHex` unchanged)
- types: `MembershipFilter`, `FilterBuildOptions`, `FilterDescription`, `FilterType`, `FingerprintBits`, `KFLT_*`

`./capability`:
- `issuePresenceCapability(p, subjectPrivHex)` — `p.salt?` (optional keyed-pool salt, omit for open) is used only to derive `memberValue`; never stored on the token
- `testWithCapability(filter, cap, now?)` — a BEARER check (reusable until `expiresAt`, not one-time)
- type `PresenceCapability` = `{ serverId, subjectPubHex, memberValue, expiresAt, sig }` (`serverId` must be colon-free and is not bound to any filter)

`./nostr` (optional; the ONLY subpath pulling in `@scure/base`, for base64 — `.` and `./capability` stay `@noble`-only):
- `buildFilterPublication({ kind, tags, blob, createdAt })` — base64-encodes `blob` into `content`, assembles `{ kind, tags, content, created_at }`; relationship-agnostic (caller supplies `kind`/`tags` — tessera-kit does not know kindred's addressing convention, the protocol naming that kenspeckle's code implements)
- `decodeFilterPublicationContent(content, maxBytes?)` — inverse; length-capped (defaults/clamps to `KFLT_MAX_BLOB_BYTES`) BEFORE decoding
- type `EventTemplate` = `{ kind, tags, content, created_at }` (structural Nostr event shape, no `nostr-tools` dep)
- lets a server that only needs to *publish* a filter depend on tessera-kit alone, with no `kenspeckle` import required

## Security

Non-enumerable is NOT non-confirmable: a held specific pubkey is always
confirmable-present. Keyed pools are a speed-bump, not a boundary. **Consumers
MUST `verifyFilterBlob`/`verifyAndParseFilter` against a pinned server key AND
the deployment's own context before trusting any hit** — a forged filter is a
doxxing primitive, and a wrong context is what stops a blob signed for one
deployment being replayed as another's. Full posture in SECURITY.md.
